name: rss
author: cristian-milea
description: Read any RSS or Atom feed on the e-ink.
long_description: A general RSS/Atom reader for the e-ink. Set any feed URL from the phone (defaults to Hacker News) — the feed is fetched directly (no third-party proxy) and parsed on-device. Choose a columns or rows headline layout and paginated auto-scroll. Some hosts block default User-Agents, and iOS may block plain-http feeds; prefer https.
